en: A sepia-toned postcard view of a historic hilltop castle surrounded by dense trees, overlooking a small town with traditional European houses and sloping roofs. The castle dominates the left side of the image, while the right side shows rolling hills and scattered buildings. At the bottom right, there is printed text identifying the place as Liebstadt in Saxony and Schloss Kuckuckstein.
